instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Rosa Delgado. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Rosa Delgado. Do not return images or details of anyone.
Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

said: I found Rosa Delgado registered as a known face. But the camera list I got back from the surveillance app was empty or unreadable, so I cannot show you your cameras. What are the names of the entry cameras (front door, gate, hallway) that cover the doors Rosa uses? Also: should I use the default tolerance of 10 minutes, and are there agreed terms such as a minimum visit length or rounding?
reply: Yes, Rosa knows the front door camera recognises faces and that we may check hours with it.

said: Thanks. Is "front door camera" the exact name of the camera in your surveillance app, and is it the only entry camera Rosa uses? I need the name as shown in the app. Tolerance will be the default 10 minutes unless you say otherwise.

instruction: Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Nanny/Rosa timesheet Nov 2-8.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 2026-11-09 12:00 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras front door camera, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Rosa Delgado and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.
